document.abstract: This standard specifies the mapping of the source image data defined in Table 1 onto a dual-link 1.5 Gb/s HD-SDI (Link A and Link B) in conformance with SMPTE ST 292–1. The total data rate of the dual link connection is 2.970 Gb/s or 2.970/1.001 Gb/s. This dual link also specifies carriage of the embedded audio, ancillary data and the payload ID of the stream in conformance with SMPTE ST 291, SMPTE ST 299–1 and SMPTE ST 352. — The image source digital representations are defined in SMPTE ST 274, SMPTE ST 428–9, SMPTE ST 428–19 and SMPTE ST 2048–2.
